title: MMEB-V3: Measuring the Performance Gaps of Omni-Modality Embedding Models
abstract: arXiv:2604.23321v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Multimodal embedding models aim to map heterogeneous inputs, such as text, images, videos, and audio, into a shared semantic space. However, existing methods and benchmarks remain largely limited to partial modality coverage, making it difficult to systematically evaluate full-modality representation learning. In this work, we take a step toward the full-modality setting. We introduce MMEB-V3, a comprehensive benchmark that evaluates embeddings across text, image, video, audio, as well as agent-centric scenarios. To enable more fine-grained diagnosis, we further construct OmniSET (Omni-modality Semantic Equivalence Tuples), where semantically equivalent instances are represented across modalities, allowing us to disentangle semantic similarity from modality effects. Through experiments on MMEB-V3, we conduct a systematic analysis of full-modality embeddings and identify three key findings: (1) models often fail to retrieve the intend

translated_title: MMEB-V3：衡量全模态嵌入模型的性能差距
translated_abstract: 多模态嵌入模型旨在将文本、图像、视频和音频等异构输入映射到共享的语义空间中。然而，现有的方法和基准在很大程度上仍局限于部分模态的覆盖，难以系统地评估全模态表示学习。在这项工作中，我们朝着全模态设置迈出了一步。我们引入了MMEB-V3，这是一个全面的基准，用于评估跨越文本、图像、视频、音频以及以智能体为中心的场景的嵌入。为了实现更细粒度的诊断，我们进一步构建了OmniSET（全模态语义等价元组），其中语义等价的实例在不同模态间进行表示，使我们能够将语义相似性与模态效应解耦。通过在MMEB-V3上的实验，我们对全模态嵌入进行了系统分析，并识别出三个关键发现：(1) 模型往往无法检索到预期的……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出覆盖文本、图像、视频、音频及智能体场景的全模态嵌入基准MMEB-V3，并构建跨模态语义等价元组数据集OmniSET，首次系统评估全模态嵌入模型性能，实现了语义相似性与模态效应的解耦分析。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces MMEB-V3, a comprehensive benchmark covering text, image, video, audio, and agent-centric scenarios, along with OmniSET—a cross-modality semantic equivalence tuple dataset—to enable the first systematic evaluation of full-modality embedding models while disentangling semantic similarity from modality effects.
